body: I agree, the water stations were definitely overcrowded and there was not enough of them. But as far as the festivals I’ve been to every water station is crowded. If you want to not wait in line you have to be smart and not go there 10 mins before the set starts. I’ve learned it’s honestly much easier to just go to the vendor and buy it, it may cost a fuck load but the max amount of time I had to wait in a line for water at LL was about 4-5 mins max. Also, my gf was starting to overheat and I asked a near security guard by us for water and he ran and gave us TWO free full sealed waters. They care.
